targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.variable == "VibracionRMS" or r.variable == "VibracionFFT1X") and r._field == "value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and (r.kpi == "mtbf_horas_demo" or r.kpi == "mttr_horas_demo" or r.kpi == "horas_detencion_no_programada") and r._field == "value") |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -12h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "anomaly_event") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "type", "score", "probable_cause", "impacted_kpis"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -12h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "maintenance_recommendation") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "probable_cause", "suggested_action", "due_before", "expected_impact"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.variable == "TemperaturaEscape" or r.variable == "PresionDiferencial" or r.tag == "FT_5101-1" or r.tag == "FT_3001") and r._field == "value")
